description: Source code for the podScope implementation in Kubernetes' topology manager, handling pod affinity, resource allocation, and topology hints.

classes.name: podScope
classes.description: Implements the Scope interface for managing pod topology and resource affinity.

methods.name: Admit
methods.description: Handles admission control for a pod, calculating affinity, setting topology hints, and allocating resources.

methods.name: accumulateProvidersHints
methods.description: Collects topology hints from all hint providers for a given pod.

methods.name: calculateAffinity
methods.description: Determines the best topology hint and whether the pod can be admitted based on policy merge.
